# HourSet

> HourSet is a strength-training app for iPhone and Android that plans a gym session every day, for the time you have, from what each muscle has recovered. Made for people new to lifting or coming back to it. No account: training data stays on the phone. US price $29.99 a year ($19.99 the first year for new subscribers) or $9.99 a month; no free trial.

- [Privacy policy](./): exactly what leaves the phone, and what never does
